Probability of a case and of a control from the posterior of T

Source: R/performanceInterval.R
window_status_probs.Rd

Model-based case/control status of one subject in the window \((s, e]\), given what was observed: the event in \((L, R]\) with type cause, or no event by \(L\) (R = Inf). With \(F_k\) the posterior cumulative mass of event type \(k\) (event_time_posterior(), linear within cells), the probability of being a case of type k is the posterior mass of \((\max(L, s), \min(R, e)]\) for the observed type over that of \((L, R]\), and of being a control (event-free at \(e\)) the mass beyond \(e\) over that of \((L, R]\). Yang et al. (2026), Biometrical Journal 68:e70108.

Usage

window_status_probs(post, L, R, cause, s, e, k)

Arguments

post

One element of event_time_posterior().

L, R, cause

The subject's observed outcome.

s, e

The window.

k

The event type evaluated.

Value

c(case = , control = ).
